questionText:

"Draupadi is supposed to have asked Yudhishthira whether he had lost himself before staking her in the fateful game of dice. Two contrary opinions were expressed in response. One was that even if Yudhishthira had lost himself earlier, his wife remained under his control, so he could stake her. The other was that an unfree man (as Yudhishthira had become when he lost himself) could not stake another person, especially a free human being. The matter remained unresolved; ultimately Dhritarashtra restored to the Pandavas and Draupadi their personal freedom.
